notes: All warnings are enforced by visible.is_empty(); they are not merely advisory.
Allowlist metadata requires nonblank reason and classification label separately; every entry must match at least one current warning.
Every frozen allowance uses symbol=None and exact path/kind plus a required source-line substring; retain full justification constants and do not infer resolved call/type identity.
Tracked TODO/FIXME predicate is separately enforced even if a general warning could be allowlisted.
Public-item detection is raw trim_start then pub-prefix; ignores use and recognizes 12 declaration-prefix strings.
Doc/attribute attachment walks prior lines; only leading gap skipped, #[ and /// / #[doc recognized; doc(hidden), non_exhaustive and exhaustive are substring tests (the last ASCII case-insensitive).
Risk checks skip trimmed // lines, otherwise raw .unwrap(), .expect(, panic! substring. A lone panic!( line joins the next nonempty trimmed line for exception matching.
CfgTestScanner is an authored raw brace counter for #[cfg(test)] then inline mod/pub mod; braces in comments/strings count and it is not Rust compilation reachability.
Source scope recursively walks crates, prunes target directories and exact raw path test/support/example/bench/bin patterns; it is not a src-only Cargo library selection.
MAX_WARNINGS_TO_PRINT=200 affects rendering only; all warning/allowance enforcement counts remain complete.
This guard scans source, including Maelstrom and simulation source; vocabulary is no evidence that these assertions execute behavioral scenarios.
